POI_ownership.before_emission: already consumed selected entry POI or another owner => reject; ordinary raw OB parent reaction consumption is not selected refined POI retirement
POI_ownership.identity: entry_POI_id immutable at emission; own reservation is exclusive ownership, not native first-test consumption
POI_ownership.native_contact_clock: selected POI native TF first eligible contact is observed at that native bar CLOSE, never backdated wick to OPEN; all inputs must be available at current event cutoff
POI_ownership.outside_POI_contact: One-grid-normalized E contact alone is sufficient modeled fill, even without raw structural POI contact; mark this explicitly. Source validity and observed queue fill not asserted.
POI_ownership.own_active_order_contact: An own active pending order executes from its bar-OPEN snapshot first. A current bar contact/consumption first known at CLOSE cannot pre-cancel that same bar fill. If still unfilled at contact known_at, retire prospectively before next OPEN. No new retry.
POI_ownership.parent_source_consumption: Only independently defined true source retirement matters; expected formation/reaction or own ownership never self-cancels order

bar_event_priority: 0 validate full observed prefix/contiguous raw M15; uncertainty => UNKNOWN/STOP
1 apply already known completed lifecycle retirement and deadline before OPEN to PENDING only
2 inherited OPEN stop/target gap safeguard before pending fill; filled OPEN gaps execute first
3 inherited limit touch and wick stop/target ambiguity; never round native OHLC or assume intrabar continuity
4 native CLOSE SFP body exit for exposure if wick rules did not already exit/mark unknown
5 publish completed TF states/POI contacts/FTA and context changes; retire remaining PENDING before next OPEN
6 at H1 cutoff only, evaluate new origins/proposals using completed states; reserve by inherited sibling/TF/ID priority

compatibility.adverse_financial_rule: minimum valid CLOSED cash/U separately in each cost column; ties lexical scenario ID; diagnostic partial closure not qualifying
compatibility.metadata_truth: synthetic model, never verified historical tick epoch; unknown account fee/mark/fill reality retained
compatibility.quantity: V=ctVal*ctMult; N=floor((1/V)/lot)*lot; reject N<=0 or N<minimum; Q=N*V<=1
compatibility.state_disagreement: eligibility/fill/CLOSED-vs-non-CLOSED disagreement => COMPATIBILITY_DISAGREEMENT/STOP; all cases retained
compatibility.touch_fill: full modeled limit fill at E, no OPEN improvement; execution-model assumption not observed order

executable_zone.entry_outside_structural_POI_allowed: Yes, if inside one-grid executable envelope and all geometry/economics pass. Limit contact can fill without native structural POI contact. This is an explicit modeled representation policy, not proof of source entry or observed historical exchange execution.
executable_zone.geometry: 0<S<E<T LONG or 0<T<E<S SHORT; raw_entry inside selected zone; opposing-zone and adverse-pool checks remain
executable_zone.structural_zone: selected entry POI range, not full raw family formation. SFP/OB use selected refined M15 POI; BREAKER body, STB body, RANGE zero-width native boundary
executable_zone.tick: active positive finite synthetic scenario tick t; zero origin

lifetime.anchor: formation_known_at from original inherited raw event, not decision or reservation time
lifetime.data_gap: UNKNOWN_DATA_GAP/STOP; do not label unfilled or infer flat exit if exposure/fill is uncertain
lifetime.pending_discovery_legacy: v3 discovery expires at decision>deadline. v4 retains the same 16h duration but makes executable availability half-open: no new order at decision>=deadline and pending order expires before bar OPEN>=deadline. This exact-boundary clarification is PROJECT_POLICY, not an unchanged v3 comparison claim.
pending_retire_if: native structural anchor strict CLOSE break
source range permanent retirement or true source invalidation, not expected parent reaction/breaker creation
selected entry POI consumed before current bar OPEN or invalidated; own reservation is not consumption
new opposite M15 BOS/CONF after frozen selected CONF; refinement no longer fresh
completed mark reaches scenario target or selected FTA object retires
lifetime.recheck_clocks: For every M15 bar OPEN, use completed D1/H4/H1/M15 states available <=OPEN, equal-cutoff advance D1,H4,H1,M15. No new signals between H1 decisions. Evaluate same inherited context admission for fixed formation/direction; no geometry amendments.
lifetime.scope: PENDING only; after fill use inherited position exits

payoff.actual_fee_slippage_reporting: base and doubled execution costs on identical scenario event path; retain exact fixed-U cash accounting, actual signed funding and adverse minima policy
payoff.admit: N2_s>=K_s with equality passing; no future funding estimate
payoff.arithmetic: exact Decimal, precision 50 with ROUND_HALF_EVEN; no epsilon or float
payoff.planned_nearest_target_net_N2_s: d*(T_s-E_s)-C_double(E_s,T_s) per one base coin; target is inward rounded, never raw FTA
payoff.planned_net_target_R_doubled_cost: N2_s/K_s; a design feasibility ratio, NOT the common qualification R denominator
payoff.planned_stop_unit_K_s: d*(E_s-S_s)+C_base(E_s,S_s) per one base coin, positive and constant for that scenario plan
payoff.qualification_U: U=abs(E_ref-S_ref)+0.0008*(E_ref+S_ref) per one base coin fixed at P01_Q001 emission, unchanged in every scenario and cost column. U is not K_s outside reference; no multiplication by Q_s, no recalculation from exit/doubled costs.
payoff.quantity_treatment: Risk parity is per base coin; Q_s>0 multiplies numerator and stop unit equally so cancels. Lot/minimum eligibility remains separately mandatory. Do not divide gate numerator by Q-adjusted or doubled K.
payoff.reference_catalog: Only reference P01_Q001 pass emits case once. All raw origins and rejected plans logged. Selected family/POI/FTA/raw geometry remain frozen. All nine scenario plans recheck H04/H05 and inherited checks; failures/disagreements cannot erase case or replace sibling.
payoff.reference_pre_emission_target_lifecycle: Completed mark must be before both raw FTA and inward reference target T_ref; test before catalog reservation; stress scenario checks T_s completion independently and retains case on failure.

rule_overrides.H04: Overrides inherited rounded-entry-inside-selected-POI and original-zone execution representability checks ONLY. Does not modify raw formation, refined-POI discovery/containment, first-test eligibility, opposing zone, stop/target/adverse-liquidity geometry, or historical metadata truth.
rule_overrides.H05: Overrides inherited base-only positive-margin admission with fixed doubled-cost planned risk-parity admission. Same gate is evaluated ONCE per scenario, independent of base/doubled reporting column; no cost-column-specific catalog. Frozen v3 policy itself is unchanged.
